metadata.data_source: Native Sales & POS; connected accounting retains its separate report.

definitions.currency: Each currency is separate. No currency conversion is applied.
definitions.dates: Invoices use issue date; payments use receipt date; returns and orders use company-local creation dates. Undated invoices are excluded from date-filtered results.
definitions.document_filters: Product/warehouse/payment filters select whole financial documents; their values remain full-document totals. Product performance uses linked invoice lines.
definitions.test_data: Only explicit test flags are excluded. Names and amounts never determine test status.

qa_stock.title: Stock & reorder planning

definitions.currency: Each currency is separate. No currency conversion is applied.
definitions.dates: Invoices use issue date; payments use receipt date; returns and orders use company-local creation dates. Undated invoices are excluded from date-filtered results.
definitions.document_filters: Product/warehouse/payment filters select whole financial documents; their values remain full-document totals. Product performance uses linked invoice lines.
definitions.test_data: Only explicit test flags are excluded. Names and amounts never determine test status.

qa_stock.stock_basis: On hand is current scoped warehouse balance. Reconciliation uses dated ledger movements; historical periods do not compare against today’s balance.
qa_stock.reorder_basis: Target is max(maximum stock, reorder threshold, recent daily issues × (lead time + safety days)) minus outstanding purchase quantities, including drafts. Review supplier commitments before ordering.
